cards.ex: I'm starving. Let's grab a bite before the movie.
cards.exUz: Men juda ochman. Kinodan oldin bir oz ovqatlanib olaylik.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson ovqatlanish, ko'pincha tez ovqat.

cards.ex: I totally pigged out on pizza last night.
cards.exUz: Men kecha kechqurun pizzani to'yib yedim.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ovqat yemoq, ayniqsa ochko'zlik bilan.

cards.ex: I'm in a total food coma after that Thanksgiving dinner.
cards.exUz: Men shu Shukrona kuni kechki ovqatidan keyin butunlay lanjman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p ovqat yegandan keyin kuchsiz va uyqusirash holati.

cards.ex: I'm trying to watch my weight, so I'm avoiding sugary drinks.
cards.exUz: Men vaznimni kuzatishga harakat qilyapman, shuning uchun shakarli ichimliklardan qochyapman.
cards.uzDef: O'z vaznini nazorat qilish, ozishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Mac and cheese is my ultimate comfort food.
cards.exUz: Makaron va pishloq mening eng sevimli xush ko'ruvchi ovqatimdir.
cards.uzDef: O'zini yaxshi his qilishiga yordam beradigan ovqat.

cards.ex: I have a huge sweet tooth; I can't resist cake.
cards.exUz: Menda shirinlikka katta ishtiyoq bor; men tortga qarshi tura olmayman.

cards.ex: I'm trying to cut back on coffee.
cards.exUz: Men kofeni kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman.

cards.ex: The portion sizes in this restaurant are huge!
cards.exUz: Bu restoranda porsiya hajmlari juda katta!

cards.ex: There's nothing like a good home-cooked meal.
cards.exUz: Uyda pishirilgan yaxshi ovqatga hech narsa yetmaydi.

cards.ex: Try to avoid processed foods as much as possible.
cards.exUz: Iloji boricha qayta ishlangan ovqatlardan qochishga harakat qiling.

cards.ex: A balanced diet is essential for good health.
cards.exUz: Muvozanatli ovqatlanish yaxshi sog'liq uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil oziq moddalarga boy ovqatlanish.

cards.ex: Don't skip breakfast; it's the most important meal of the day.
cards.exUz: Nonushtani o'tkazib yubormang; bu kunning eng muhim ovqatidir.

cards.ex: I think I got food poisoning from that seafood.
cards.exUz: O'ylashimcha, men shu dengiz mahsulotidan ovqatdan zaharlanganman.

cards.ex: She's been on a diet for a month and has already lost weight.
cards.exUz: U bir oydan beri dietada va allaqachon vazn yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Vazn yo'qotish yoki sog'lom ovqatlanish uchun maxsus ovqatlanish rejimi.

cards.ex: She only buys health food from the organic market.
cards.exUz: U faqat organik bozordan sog'lom ovqat sotib oladi.

cards.ex: My son is such a picky eater; he only eats chicken nuggets.
cards.exUz: O'g'lim juda tanlab ovqat yeydi; u faqat tovuq nagetslarini yeydi.

cards.ex: Running is a great way to burn calories.
cards.exUz: Yugurish - kaloriya yoqishning ajoyib usuli.

cards.ex: I know junk food is bad for me, but it's so delicious.
cards.exUz: Bilaman, zararli ovqat menga yomon, lekin u juda mazali.
cards.uzDef: Oz foydali oziq moddalari bo'lgan ovqat.

cards.ex: We had a slap-up meal at that fancy restaurant last night.
cards.exUz: Biz kecha kechqurun shu hashamatli restoranda to'laqonli ovqat yedik.

cards.ex: I went on a chocolate binge last weekend.
cards.exUz: Men o'tgan hafta oxirida shokoladni to'yib yedim.
cards.uzDef: Bir vaqtning o'zida ko'p miqdorda nimadir iste'mol qilish (odatda ovqat).

cards.ex: During college, I practically lived on ramen noodles.
cards.exUz: Kollejda o'qigan paytimda, men deyarli faqat ramen noodle bilan ovqatlanib yashardim.
cards.uzDef: Faqat ma'lum bir ovqat bilan ovqatlanib yashash.

cards.ex: I usually get a grab-and-go breakfast from the cafe.
cards.exUz: Men odatda kafedan ol va ket usulida nonushta olaman.
cards.uzDef: Tez tayyorlangan va sotiladigan ovqat yoki ichimlik.

cards.ex: This restaurant uses a farm-to-table approach.
cards.exUz: Bu restoranda fermadan stolga usuli qo'llaniladi.

cards.ex: Kale is considered a superfood.
cards.exUz: Kale superovqat deb hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'plab foydali oziq moddalari bo'lgan ovqat.

cards.ex: Can I have a second helping of mashed potatoes?
cards.exUz: Kartoshka pyuresidan yana bir porsiya olsam bo'ladimi?

cards.ex: She eats like a bird; I don't know how she stays so thin.
cards.exUz: U qushdek yeydi; bilmayman, u qanday qilib bunchalik ozg'in bo'lib qoladi.

cards.ex: He wolfed down his sandwich in two bites.
cards.exUz: U sendvichini ikki tishlashda tez yutib yubordi.

cards.ex: She cooked up a storm for the party.
cards.exUz: U ziyofat uchun juda ko'p va yaxshi ovqat tayyorladi.

cards.ex: This recipe is as easy as pie.
cards.exUz: Bu retsept suvdek oson.

cards.ex: That documentary gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: Bu hujjatli film menga ko'p o'ylashga sabab bo'ldi.
